text: {"reason":"Change the medium/high branch action from supplier switch to alert-planner. v1 made 34 switches and incurred $2.165M cost with 4 stockouts; alert-planner costs $35,000 versus $45,000 and always arrives on time. This weakly reduces cost and stockouts on every switched row, including both $195,000 stockout examples.","source":"(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days) (cond ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'high)) (< inventory-days 5)) (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review)) ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium)) (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review)) (else (list 'monitor))))"}
